name: Brow tint kit

lead: A brow tint kit contains a semi-permanent dye and developer that darkens eyebrow hairs for several weeks. It is used to fill in sparse or pale brows so they look denser.
Salons offer the service, while home kits are cheaper. Effects on skin fade faster than on hair, and the safety concern is mainly contact allergy.

paras: The dye deposits pigment into the hair shaft and temporarily stains skin underneath. A processing time of a few minutes is followed by removal.

Many tints contain PPD or related compounds, and case reports describe allergic dermatitis and eye involvement after eyebrow and eyelash dye. Patch testing is advised, and dye should never get into the eye. Evidence is limited to case reports, with no controlled trials.
